docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
An early Prākrit grammar, the Prākṛta-prakāśa of Vararuci, with Bhāmaha’s commentary Manoramā, edited with an English translation and notes by Cowell (London, 1854). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Prákrita-prakása; or, The Prákrit grammar. With the commentary (Manoramá) of Bhámaha. The first complete ed. of the original text, with various readings from a collation of six mss. in the Bodleian Library at Oxford, and the libraries of the Royal Asiatic Society and the East India House. With copious notes, an English translation, and index of Prákrit words; to which is prefixed an easy introd. to Prákrit grammar · Wara Ruci, Bhamaha, Cowell, Edward B. (Edward Byles), 1826-1903 · 1854, 254 scanned pages. Published 1854; Edward Byles Cowell died 1903; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
